traditional: Communication, commerce, and contracts fused with love, money, and pleasure. The two act as one and the combined significations are hard to separate.
modern: Mind meets charm. Speech and thought take on grace and an artistic flair. Only the conjunction and sextile are possible. Fused, these drives are difficult to separate and ask to be consciously integrated rather than acted out blindly.

cyclic.meaning: A new cycle of thinking and connection is sown: instinctive, full of potential, not yet conscious of itself.

business: Concentrated focus in this area. Diplomacy, the arts, and any work where pleasant, persuasive expression matters.
shadow: Scattered overthinking fused with indulgence and vanity, with no distance to tell them apart.
arcApplying: The two fuse and intensify as they close in.
arcSeparating: The fused theme peaks and discharges.

readerCopy.summary: A public announcement turns a private agreement into a social fact.
readerCopy.body: A public announcement turns a private agreement into a social fact. A partnership, payment, invitation, creative deal, or change in status is named in language carefully chosen to shape how the news will be received. Mercury delivers the message, while Venus ties every word to value, approval, and the relationship being defined. Under the conjunction, the wording and the agreement become part of the same offer. The announcement may bring people together, but any ambiguity in the terms now carries a much larger audience.
